name: Ningyo no Hiyaku wa Koi no Jumon
original_name: 人魚の秘薬は恋の呪文
source:
Rishia, a rather careless mermaid, was once saved by a prince. 
When she learned that this same prince had fallen ill, she gave up her voice 
for a pair of legs to go to him and impart "the mermaid's secret"---. 

The tale of Rishia the mermaid, the gardener Eddie, the tender knight Yujin, 
and of course Prince Gilbert, the man who saved Rishia's life. 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE155027.html]DL Site English[/url]]
translation:
莉希亚（Rishia）是一条相当粗心的美人鱼，曾经被一位王子救了。
当她得知这位王子病倒时，她放弃了自己的声音 
一双腿走到他身边，传授“人鱼的秘密”——。

人鱼莉希亚、园丁艾迪、温柔的骑士尤金的故事，
当然还有吉尔伯特王子，他救了莉希亚的命。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE155027.html]DLsite English[/url]]
